GUIDES.TITLE: Practical guides
GUIDES.INTRO: Four things customers ask about most, kept short.
GUIDES.GALV_1: Hot-dip galvanizing coats steel in zinc. The zinc corrodes first and protects the steel underneath, even where the coating has been scratched.
GUIDES.GALV_2: For outdoor work - fencing, gates, railings, anything the rain reaches - galvanized is the usual choice.
GUIDES.GALV_3: Untreated (black) steel is cheaper and is the one you paint, powder-coat or weld before finishing. Left outside bare, it rusts.
GUIDES.GALV_4: For indoor fabrication and anything that will be painted, black steel is usually enough.
GUIDES.TUBE_1: Two different numbers get called "the size". Nominal bore (DN15, 1/2") describes the bore for pipework and is not the outside diameter.
GUIDES.TUBE_2: The outside diameter and the wall thickness (33.7 x 3.2 mm, for instance) describe the tube itself, and that is what a fabricator measures.
GUIDES.TUBE_3: Square and rectangular tube is named by its outside dimensions and its wall: 40 x 40 x 2 mm.
GUIDES.TUBE_4: When ordering, give the outside dimensions and the wall; if a drawing says DN, say which you mean.
GUIDES.SHEET_1: Sheet is sold by thickness in millimetres, and the difference between 0.5 and 0.7 mm decides what a panel will do.
GUIDES.SHEET_2: 0.5 mm for decoration and door tops; 1-2 mm for parts that carry weight; 3 mm and up for plate.
GUIDES.SHEET_3: A sheet also has its own size (1000 x 2000, 1250 x 2500, 1500 x 3000), and the price is usually given per sheet or per square metre.
GUIDES.SHEET_4: Which is why both numbers matter when you compare.
GUIDES.DRAW_1: A DXF goes straight into the machine; a PDF or a photograph has to be redrawn, which costs time and invites mistakes.
GUIDES.DRAW_2: Whatever the format: the outline of every part, the dimensions, the thickness and the material, and how many of each.
GUIDES.DRAW_3: Mark the holes with their diameters, and say which edges have to be square or smooth.
GUIDES.DRAW_4: Without a drawing, a dimensioned sketch and the quantity are enough to quote from.
GUIDES.ASK: Cannot find the size you need? Send the list or the drawing and we will price it.
